column92: WYOMING GAME AND FISH DEPARTMENT PROPOSES TO REMOVE ENCROACHING CONIFERS AND CHEMICALLY TREAT UNDESIRABLESPECIES ON UP TO 2,500 ACRES IN ASPEN, RIPARIAN AND SAGEBRUSH COMMUNITIES ON BLM, STATE AND PRIVATE LANDS IN THE BIG HORN BASIN CODY AND WORLAND FIELD OFFICES. PRESCRIPTIONS FOR CONIFER REMOVAL WILL VARY BY COMMUNITY TYPE AND DESIRED RESULTS BUT WILL INCLUDE JACKSTRAWING, LOP AND SCATTER AND PILE AND BURN. ALL TREATMENTS WILL BE CONDUCTED BY A PRIVATE CONTRACTORS USING CHAINSAWS AND OR TRACKED OR WHEELED EQUIPMENT WITH MASTICATING ATTACHMENTS. TREATED AREAS WILL ACT AS NATURAL FIREBREAKS ON THE LANDSCAPE. RESILIENCE TO WILDFIRE IN ASPEN, RIPARIAN AND SAGEBRUSH STEPPE WILL BE IMPROVED AND WILDFIRE BEHAVIOR WITHIN AND ADJACENT TO TREATED STANDS WILL BE MODERATED THROUGH CONIFER REMOVAL. WILDLAND FIRE BURN SEVERITY AND DURATION WITHIN THESE COMMUNITIES WILL BE REDUCED. TREATMENT OF UNDESIRABLE SPECIES SUCH AS CHEATGRASS WILL INCLUDE GROUND AND AERIAL APPLICATIONS OF HERBICIDE. CHEMICAL CONTROL OF ANNUAL GRASSES AND OTHER HIGHLY FLAMMABLE SPECIES WILL REDUCE FIRE SPREAD.
